description: This file defines a plugin for Playwright that gathers Git commit information and CI environment details, and integrates it into test metadata. It includes functions for fetching git logs, diffs, and CI info, and sets up a plugin with a setup method.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Logs messages prefixed with 'GitCommitInfo: ' to the console.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs debug messages if the environment variable DEBUG_GIT_COMMIT_INFO is set.

methods.name: ciInfo
methods.description: Detects CI environment (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and returns relevant CI info.

methods.name: gitCommitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the latest git commit info including hash, author, and branch.

methods.name: gitDiff
methods.description: Computes the diff of the current git state, considering CI environment and uncommitted changes.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with a timeout and returns the output or undefined on failure.
